title: devin-orchestrator task spec
description: Structured signals the calling agent supplies to plan_task(). The planner decides *whether* to fan out; the model decides *how* to decompose.

independent_units.description: Count of genuinely disjoint work units.

needs_write.description: Workers need write access; false selects the read-only profile.

est_unit_minutes.description: Optional default duration per unit, in minutes. Feeds --cost-estimate only; it is a planning label, not billing.

units_detail.description: Optional per-unit file declarations used by the disjointness check (OR-4). Paths are declared, never read.

est_minutes.description: Optional per-unit duration estimate in minutes for --cost-estimate.
